stateKeys.name: derived
stateKeys.type: 'QUEUED'|'RUNNING'|'FAILED'|'CANCELLED'|'COMPLETED' -- the rolled-up workflow-run status computed from taskStatuses

stateKeys.name: taskStatuses
stateKeys.type: fixed 3-element array, each 'QUEUED'|'RUNNING'|'EVICTED'|'CANCELLED'|'FAILED'|'COMPLETED' -- one status per task in the workflow run

specialRules.name: all-same-status-passes-through
specialRules.note: When every task shares the same status, derived equals that status exactly (the len(uniqueStatuses)==1 branch) -- including 'derived' becoming COMPLETED, which is otherwise unreachable any other way.

specialRules.name: failed-dominates-except-when-uniform
specialRules.note: Any task FAILED (given tasks are not all identical) forces derived=FAILED, regardless of how many tasks already COMPLETED.

specialRules.name: in-flight-family-beats-cancelled-and-completed
specialRules.note: Any task QUEUED, RUNNING, or EVICTED (and no FAILED present, and not all identical) forces derived=RUNNING -- even alongside CANCELLED or COMPLETED tasks. Checked BEFORE the CANCELLED branch, so a mix of CANCELLED+QUEUED reports RUNNING, not CANCELLED.

specialRules.name: cancelled-only-when-no-failed-and-no-inflight
specialRules.note: derived=CANCELLED requires at least one CANCELLED task, no FAILED task, and no QUEUED/RUNNING/EVICTED task remaining (and not all-identical, which is the pass-through branch instead).

specialRules.name: evicted-treated-as-inflight-not-its-own-bucket
specialRules.note: EVICTED is grouped with QUEUED/RUNNING for precedence purposes (forces RUNNING), never treated as a distinct terminal outcome.
